timing.note: relative to the checkout-abandonment event; every stated deadline, price, or scarcity fact comes from the approved offer version in the brief, never invented

buyer_type_tactics.spontaneous: fastest send in the 1-3 hour window; friction-free one-click finish; Zeigarnik + loss aversion; countdown framing only when the brief supplies a real deadline
buyer_type_tactics.methodical: answer the unspoken objection; guarantee, security signals, FAQ or support link; no pressure; trust/risk reduction
buyer_type_tactics.humanistic: a real human check-in; offer help from a person; reciprocity + trust
buyer_type_tactics.competitive: name what waiting costs; price protection or stock claim only when the approved offer version supplies it; status-coded loss aversion

rules.suppression: a verified purchase, an active order for the same offer, or an opt-out suppresses every remaining email immediately; a pending or failed payment is not a decline and belongs to the failed-payment lane, never this profile
rules.offer_validity: every CTA, price, benefit, guarantee, and deadline matches the current approved offer version; no expired one-click link, no second unapproved offer, no discount that the approved version does not carry
rules.intake: the approved S49 shared-launch brief, consumed by the launch intake adapter with per-field provenance; the legacy one-block questionnaire applies only in explicit legacy interactive mode
rules.review_labels: the private client-review document labels each email with its framework and labels the body 'Email Body:'; the recipient payload carries no framework labels, slot instructions, or production commentary
rules.trigger: Signature Launch build: appended after the checkout page is approved and the offer version is locked; a checkout-abandonment event enrolls the contact and every email returns them to that same approved checkout page
rules.registration_note: not yet in catalog-index.json / catalog-built-index.json and not yet in SEQ_LENGTHS / PREVIEW_EXPECTED / _sequence_type; the shared prover also applies its default 150-300 word band (3-B <150), so this profile's compact <150 band is not modeled yet. Until the integrator registers the profile and its band, a run resolving sequence_type signature_launch_abandoned_checkout fails AF-EMAIL-TYPE-MISMATCH by design; register.py --check keeps its frozen 36-entry census
